title: Exploring the Practicality of Generative Retrieval on Dynamic Corpora
selection_reason: Generative retrieval for dynamic corpora uses a language model to retrieve documents and reports lower inference FLOPs, faster indexing, and lower storage than dual-encoder retrieval; it directly studies inference efficiency.
